scenario_name: 1 omitted dimensions; intended use: Senior Day Center (CDI / CDIA / CDAA / CDAI)
initial_query: I am looking for an office building. I intend to convert it into an autonomous senior day center (CDIA). The location is in Turin. I need a property with at least 360 sqm of gross floor area and capacity for 18 people. I prefer a property in energy class D or better.
submitted_query: I am looking for an office building. I intend to convert it into an autonomous senior day center (CDIA). The location is in Turin. I need a property with at least 360 sqm of gross floor area and capacity for 18 people. I prefer a property in energy class D or better.
final_sql: SELECT * FROM ESTATES WHERE property_type = 'Offices and similar' AND surface_area >= 360 AND energy_class IN ('A1', 'A2', 'A3', 'A4', 'B', 'C', 'D') AND haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) <= 3.0 ORDER BY haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) ASC
